newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTANI RUPEE ENDS STEADY IN KERB, SEEN STABLE.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTANI RUPEE ENDS STEADY IN KERB, SEEN STABLE.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady at 41.30 to the dollar on Monday on heavy dollar supply and dealers said it would stay stable in the near term.

"There was pretty good dollar supply today, which matched demand," said a dealer at Khanani & Kalia International. "In the international market, the dollar was firm against most major currencies except sterling. But the rupee will maintain its levels because speculative interest in the dollar has eased."
The central bank rate was 40.5200/40.7226 to the dollar. The premium on forex bearer certificates ended unchanged at 2.0 percent. -- Amir Zia (9221) 5685192; Fax (9221) 5673428
